component.name: Plain Office
component.summary: Private office suite: documents, sheets, slides and PDFs

description.p: Write documents, build spreadsheets, make presentations, and edit, scan and convert PDFs — with no account, no ads, no tracking and no internet connection.

ul.li: Opens and saves Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files, and opens OpenDocument and many more formats
Opens Pages, Numbers and Keynote files to read (not edit)
PDF editor: add text, draw, highlight, sign, and rotate, reorder or combine pages
Document scanner and on-device text recognition (OCR)

description.p: Everything stays on your device. The app has no network access.
